origin.scope: All 70 immutable authored source controls, complete public CLI JSON expectations. No CLI execution or original-project-matrix completion is claimed by this manifest. Actual execution receipts are printed by lint_legacy_instance_api_cli.rs in the existing Actions archive lane.
origin.order: Exact native message order. crates/vize/src/commands/lint.rs calls aggregate::sorted_totals -> sort_details_for_output -> compare_diagnostic (start/end/severity/rule/message/help); all 70 source packets already use that order. Assertions do not sort or filter actual diagnostics.
origin.help: --help-level full; both immutable native help strings are already plain text. Labels and fixes remain checked by the complete immutable native API contracts; they are not fields of the public JSON formatter.

messages.message: [vize:script/no-deprecated-dollar-listeners-api] $listeners was removed in Vue 3 and merged into $attrs
messages.help: Replace $listeners with $attrs. In Vue 3 listeners are passed as on-prefixed props and are exposed through $attrs (or useAttrs() in the Composition API).
